study: Generic development of single-person object recognition by distilling other viewers' photo-specific confusions among wrong candidate objects
historical_comparator: The registered shared_trial_encoder study already aligned centered EEG embeddings between people for ten photographs within a known class. It evaluated object classification and failed its primary gate. Here each student has an independent full network. Teachers provide only their probability distribution over the eleven wrong objects in a common twelve-object menu, with the within-fold class mean removed. No coordinate matching or shared network weights.
generic_split: Use the historical 416 plus the 512 additional generic classes for fitting. The same 96 development objects are forbidden in all learned statistics, teacher fits, auxiliary menus and student training. The original 96-class twelve- and four-way query/support menus are reproduced separately for each person. These are previously used development objects.
joint_schedule: The 928-object training pool contains 64 combinations of recording-session pairs across all three viewers. Exactly 52 combinations have at least twelve objects, totaling 816 eligible training objects. Each auxiliary episode uses 12 distinct objects from one such combination: every candidate has the same pair for each participant. The held 96 have no jointly matched 12-candidate cell, so their scoring uses the historical recipient-specific same-session menus and that person's EEG only.
teachers: Assign whole training joint-session cells to four class-disjoint folds, seeded and balanced by size. Per person per fold, fit the original 1500-update personal trial encoder and Fisher96 on objects of the other folds. Encode the held-fold photos, preserving their original image IDs. All 12 classes in an auxiliary episode come from the same fold, so every candidate has one common independently fitted teacher representation space. Teachers are frozen before student training.
fixed_rule: Teachable evidence is defined per query, per photograph pair, and per eight-support menu. Exclude the true candidate before standardizing the eleven cosine scores. Average standardized neural and Fisher scores per teacher. Center each wrong-candidate score across the two held photographs of its class/fold. Average both other teachers' centered vectors and apply softmax at temperature one. Apply the same removal, standardization and within-pair centering to the student's neural scores. Add target-to-student KL with fixed coefficient 0.25. No hyperparameter grid or candidate selection on the historical held 96.
optimization: All nine student fits (three people by three arms) have identical personal architecture, 1500 AdamW updates, original same-session personal object/within-photo loss and seed 260553, cosine decay, data, episode, dropout and auxiliary sampling schedules within person. Each update additionally computes one joint 12-object episode with all four presentations and dropout disabled. Only training accesses the two peer teacher vectors. The zero-KL arm computes the same auxiliary forwards with zero coefficient. The sham exchanges the two held teacher rows within each true object/fold, preserving all eleven alternatives, teacher, session, eight supports, and aggregate soft-label distribution.
readouts: At inference use only the recipient's own four presentations and eight EEG support photos per candidate. Primary fixed equal mix of standardized neural and recipient Fisher scores. The original .59078 fresh-mix coefficient is excluded since the 96 classes entered some of that earlier study's feature fits. Report neural-only, same-menu wrong-query, and matched-minus-original historical independent 416-class mixed readout as secondary.
gate: For the pooled twelve-way mixed decisions require positive 95% paired-object lower bounds against both the same-class different-photo soft labels and zero auxiliary weight. Require nonnegative pooled mixed hit differences against both controls at four-way and against the original independent twelve-way mixture. Sample 96 shared objects with replacement, retaining all ten photos and all three subjects, 10000 draws, seed 260633. Record gains, losses, and per-person totals. A passing result authorizes a separately locked evaluation of known personal12 and 35-object menus as reuse, never as fresh confirmation. No target data or generation on failure.
